scope: Proposition 3.9 (Projective adjoint comparison) of the manuscript “Logarithmic Kodaira dimension and whole-fiber variation” (preprints/Logarithmic-Kodaira-dimension-and-whole-fiber-variation-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b1b750b309e5c5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let P be smooth connected projective, let D be reduced SNC, and let L be the rational parabolic extension of the entire highest Hodge line of a polarizable integral pure variation on P \ D. There are a birational morphism µ : P′ → P with P′ smooth projective, a surjective morphism a : P′ → R with connected fibers to a smooth projective variety, and a nef rational line bundle A on R such that (3.14) µ∗ L ∼Q a∗ A, KR + bA is big for all sufficiently large rational b. The point quotient is allowed, in which case µ∗L is rationally trivial.
